The most horrifying account comes from Thomas Whitfield, who encountered a faceless child figure that defies explanation. Journalist Edward Blake’s investigation only deepened the enigma, documenting eerie voices and unreachable cliffside campsites.

This 10:57-minute video uncovers the unresolved fate of these pioneers, blending history, suspense, and the supernatural. Explore the vanished wagon train, mysterious caves, and the shadowed valleys where time seems suspended. Briell Decker is a former plural wife of Warren Jeffs, leader of the Fundamentalist Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints, or FLDS, a polygamist sect widely considered a cult.

Decker married Jeffs at 18 and spent eight years inside the group while it was being investigated by several law enforcement agencies. Decker explains how the FLDS manipulated its members, including through arranged marriages, financial control, isolation, and the use of religious authority to enforce obedience. She also describes her multiple escape attempts and the pressure the church used to keep members from leaving.

Warren Jeffs was arrested in 2006 and, in 2011, was sentenced to life in prison plus 20 years for sexually assaulting underage girls.

Decker now works with people leaving polygamist communities as founder of the Short Creek Dream Center. She appeared in the HBO Max/Discovery+ documentary "Prisoner of the Prophet."

If you are a survivor of sexual assault, you can call the National Sexual Assault Hotline (1-800-656-4673) or visit its website to receive confidential support.

snippet.title: The Most Deformed Animals Humans Have Made
snippet.description:
The Most Deformed Animals Humans Have Made explores how selective breeding created some of the most unhealthy and genetically extreme animals on Earth. From French bulldogs, pugs, Persian cats, and Scottish Fold cats to Belgian Blue cattle, broiler chickens, ligers, and exotic bully dogs, discover the unintended consequences of breeding animals for appearance, size, and profit.

This video covers fancy goldfish, fancy pigeons, fancy rabbits, ligers, Belgian Blue cattle, Persian cats, pugs, English bulldogs, teacup dogs, broiler chickens, Scottish Fold cats, meat-farmed turkeys, Cavalier King Charles Spaniels, French bulldogs, exotic French bulldogs, and Exotic Bully dogs. Learn why each breed was created, the traits humans selected for, and the serious health problems many now face as a result of selective breeding.

snippet.title: 'I was shot in the face': Amy's 'lucky' escape | From the vault
snippet.description:
Amy Matthews was caught in a 2014 shooting in New Orleans while on a holiday after finishing university.

The 21-year-old Perth woman was shot in the face in a gang shooting on notorious Bourbon Street. CCTV footage of the shooting shows the busy street deserted seconds after the shooting started.

"I heard the first shot… it’s not something you hear usually like it’s a sound you’d never hear, so my brain was struggling to figure out what it was in the beginning," Amy told reporter PJ Madam.

Amy travelled back to New Orleans recently for the first time to meet them men who saved her life.

snippet.title: The Woman Who Sold Fake Love and Beauty | The Victorian Beauty Scam That Fooled High Society
snippet.description:
Step into the shadowy world of Victorian London, where beauty, deception, and manipulation collide in one of the most disturbing true crime stories of the 19th century. This 11:29-minute documentary uncovers the chilling case of Madame Seraphine, a cunning con artist who built an empire on false promises of eternal youth and love.

Operating from a mysterious salon on New Bond Street, she targeted wealthy, vulnerable women, exploiting their fears of aging and loneliness. With fabricated identities, forged love letters, and dangerous beauty treatments laced with toxic chemicals, she created an illusion so powerful that her victims willingly surrendered their fortunes.

At the center of this tragic story is Eleanor Whitcombe, a widow drawn into an elaborate romance scam involving a fictional nobleman. What began as hope quickly turned into financial and emotional devastation.

This true crime story explores themes of psychological manipulation, Victorian beauty standards, fraud schemes, and the dark side of human vulnerability. If you’re fascinated by historical crime cases, scams, and stories of deception, this is a must-watch.

👉 Watch till the end to uncover how this shocking case exposed the hidden dangers behind beauty obsession—and why similar scams still exist today.
